notes.title: Caveirão Zeus
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900742/390199f4689c65ec458a483ac5cad7851b15c7a9.jpg[/img]

The first [b]Caveirões[/b] of the game are ready! There are 3 versions of the [b]Caveirão Zeus[/b] reproduced in the smallest details, including their respective original plates.

[previewyoutube=fq1lM6fNVag;full][/previewyoutube]

In the future there will be missions where you can not only enter them but also drive them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900742/6c735a92084b56beb5aa6d3868518d4d8c4d0259.jpg[/img]

I hope you like it! More news coming soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900742/a8482b8cec82485fc366f8144662359ea350e644.jpg[/img]

Remember that you can play [b]Call of Duty Rio[/b] right now completely free while [b]Comando Rio[/b] is being developed. The servers are in Rio/Brazil only, but you can get a little taste of the real deal aside the ping. Details about both projects at [url=https://comando.rio.br][b]https://comando.rio.br/[/b][/url] (in Portuguese Only) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900742/82eb308b671c3fac82eed83a16c4b10b9d18341b.jpg[/img]

Please follow us @ [url=https://www.youtube.com/@Comando-Rio][b]YouTube[/b][/url] to get the latest news!

notes.title: Comando Rio has been nominated for the Games of the Year Awards 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900742/79bce966aa3bdc6b9127f51eedcb905754070886.png[/img]

[b]Comando Rio[/b] has been nominated for the [b]Games of the Year Awards 2024[/b] at [b]Global Games Pitch[/b]

All the Details : https://globalgamespitch.com/awards/


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900742/6ea5da0ef5f3f290894335d893657a4b65c043a3.png[/img]

I was surprised by an [b]email[/b] informing me that [b]Comando Rio[/b] had been nominated for the award, mainly because not even a single gameplay of the game has been published yet. That's why I believe it will be in the Upcoming category.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900742/31144732eef04bfbdac062a3056749c9ffc80368.png[/img]

We still have a long way to go before we have something really good to present here. I can't wait to play it online with all of you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900742/993f471eba664e6ed36c0eb56a7cd109e326e5cf.png[/img]

Little by little we'll get there, just like we did with [b]Call of Duty Rio[/b]. Thank you to everyone who is supporting me, I hope to exceed all of the already high expectations.

notes.title: Counter-Strike creator support & more!
notes.content:
When I showed my old friend Minh “[b]Gooseman[/b]” Le ([b]Counter-Strike[/b] creator) my new project based on [b]Call of Duty Rio[/b], he simply sent it to me immediately without even asking for all his [b]45 Asset Packs[/b] so I could use them in [b]Commando Rio[/b]. Amazing, right? Thanks a lot, my friend!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900742/f3487a308d75d9ddb97fd3321083586c381e55ab.jpg[/img]

In addition to him, I was also lucky enough to close great partnerships with [b]Lemniscate VFX[/b] from Poland, who provided me with cinematic-quality favela assets, as well as the Brazilian [b]Iron Edge Arsenal[/b], who is providing the first weapons for the game.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900742/e948cdc21a0c6c7e1bede897596dbd09afca43ad.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900742/2053578c142d74706904d109503fa786e1f179e6.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900742/d34311d1641d0ee6eddf750150bbd3689ec1d699.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900742/64b824cebab1fd704e2bd93fee9b4d9b00c68f90.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900742/bd63895a3998a041521f138665ffa8802ac39b2a.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900742/b42979a34f0f5c97ff520b95da674d00b244dee1.jpg[/img][/url]

Since I don’t just want to release “another game” and I’m very concerned about quality, this help is being fundamental at this early stage of development. It also shows their trust in the quality of the project, which gives me more confidence and enthusiasm, attesting that I’m on the right track.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900742/e85aa7662659c0ca737cdffb94282df470488ea4.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Teaser and More Screenshots
notes.content:
After the [b]First Wave[/b] of financing we began to reap the rewards of the little that came in and transform it into something incredible. All Screenshots and the new Teaser are great! I can't even believe they turned out so amazing! They FAR exceeded what I expected, and I hope they also exceeded your expectations.

[previewyoutube=zkedGI3OwgE;full][/previewyoutube]

The [b]Steam[/b] page has been updated with the new [b]Teaser[/b] and several [b]Screenshots[/b].

The work doesn't stop and has evolved a lot every week. We are in the final steps of blocking the first map and testing gameplay. We are also going to start working with the [b]BOPE[/b] Soldiers to start using them in future tests.

Everyone who participated in the funding waves is having access to videos and constant updates of the entire development, and it is thanks to them that we are reaching such a high level in this project.

Thank you very much again to everyone who is by my side in yet another project that is very out of the ordinary, as well as everyone who has supported me over these almost 40 years.

And for those of you who still have no idea what this game is about or the success of [b]Call of Duty Rio[/b], I strongly suggest you watch the film [b]Tropa de Elite[/b] ([url=https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0861739/][b]Elite Squad[/b][/url]) and you will understand.

Caveira!

notes.title: Fruits of the First Wave
notes.content:
We reached the end of [b]Wave 01[/b] to help me finance [b]Comando Rio[/b]. 100% were [b]Call of Duty Rio[/b] players, which was already expected, but we had 4 supporters from outside Brazil, 3 from Portugal and 1 from USA. It was a pleasant surprise!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900742/b262856c8b52bba780b92f111293cff73a4b8f3f.jpg[/img]

Thank you all for the support! [b]Wave 02[/b] (still restricted to the website) is now active! Come and participate in all the development, testing and playing [b]BEFORE[/b] everyone else! Soon will be also available at [b]Kickstarter[/b] as soon as I have more content to show.

These are two [b]Screenshots[/b] made with [b]Assets[/b] purchased today with backers' money. This goes beyond helping with the graphic quality of Comando Rio, it will also greatly speed up the development of the maps, in addition to of course making the environment more and more real as never before when portraying my beloved and chaotic city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900742/484a55a0fe95e74f9d55a9a446706a81813875e6.jpg[/img]

Thank you guys! You are amazing! 😉

#comandorio #callofdutyrio

notes.title: Roadmap is now Public
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900742/76000b9dd6152f58418e1913c3d84c1bca31768c.png[/img]

For those who don't know my development method, it is now public for everyone to see. 

There's no reason to change what has been working for decades, so I'm going to keep the same Roadmap as always, which I used in practically all my projects, including the most recent Call of Duty Rio and it was particularly successful.

[b]Stage 00[/b] (100% Done)

. Idea
. Main Concept
. Plot
. Design Plan
. Paths Decisions

[b]Stage 01[/b] (100% Done)

. Basic Movement
. Fire/Damage
. Basic Gametypes (TDM/DOM)
. Multiplayer/Netcode/Connection
. Optimizations
. Steam Presence
. [url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/comando-rio]IndieDB[/url] Presence
. Personal Pages (Facebook/Instagram)
. Free Propaganda

[b]Stage 02[/b]

. Public Roadmap
. New Site Design
. Setup Campaigns to Spread the word
. Playermodels (at least 1 to each side)
. FPS Feel (Movements/Sounds over Materials/Etc)
. New Movements / Anims
. Jump/Mantle Anims
. Stances Anims
. Death Anims
. Weapons (at least 1 to each side)
. Optimizations
. Free Propaganda

[b]Stage 03[/b]

. First Map (Medium Size)
. Rio Storms
. More Playermodels
. More Weapons
. AI Improvements
. Optimizations
. Free Propaganda

[b]Stage 05[/b]

. Lots of Tests

. Optimizations

[b]Stage 06[/b]

. Minimap
. Helicopters
. Fireworks
. Dogs
. Favela Daylife (NPCs such as Womans/Kids/Workers/Dogs/Cats/Rats/Etc)

. Lots of Tests
. AI Improvements
. Optimizations
. Free Propaganda

[b]Stage 07[/b]

. Steam Integration
. Epic Integration
. Lots of Tests
. Optimizations
. Free Propaganda

[b]Stage 08[/b]

. Closed Alpha for supporters only
. Lots of Tests
. Fix all bugs found
. Gameplay Improvements
. Optimizations
. Free Propaganda

[b]Stage 09[/b]

. Open Alpha (Earlier Access Release)
